main_text.p: tice prauitatis (Vergerio teste, qui optime nouit) mix triginta annorum spacio, centum quinquaginta Christianorum millia, diuersis afflictationum generibus consumpsit, neq; adhuc definit. Exurgat ergo Deus, & dissipentur inimici eius, atq; ut fumus deficit, & illi deficiant, ac statim pereant à facie illius. Exurgat inquam, ac sanctorum suorum sanguinem vindicet, qui pro confessione sui sancti nominis & doctrinæ, crudeliter est effusus.
Finiunt Acta Romanorum pontificum à dispersione discipulorum Christi, usq; ad obitum Pauli quarti: ex Ioannis Balei Su-douolgij Angli maiore Anglicorum scriptorum Catalogo desumpta.

page.notes: The word "Exurgat" in the first paragraph is underlined in the print. Small printer's marks in the right margin near the top are not text. "mix" at the start of the second line is uncertain. "Su-douolgij" is a guess at a word split across lines and is marked [?] in the text. The signature "l 3" and the catchword "Hæc" are uncertain readings.
